Detroit Red Wings at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Justin Faulk and Michael Brandsegg-Nygård scored 45 seconds apart early in the third period, goalie Daniil Tarasov defeated his former team and the surging Detroit Red Wings beat the Florida Panthers 5-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Faulk, Brandsegg-Nygård score early in 3rd, lift Red Wings past Panthers 5-3
